summary.en: A surface-mounted case on the inside of the door with a cylinder through the door face. Pulling the inside knob retracts the latch; the outside is key-only. Universally fitted, cheap, and mechanically simple — but the case geometry varies more than any other family.
summary.zh: 门内侧贴面安装的锁体，锁芯穿过门面。拉内侧旋钮收回斜舌，外侧只能用钥匙。安装极普遍、便宜、机构简单——但锁体外形的差异比其他任何锁族都大。

notes.en: The spring is the enemy: retracting a spring latch under motor drive takes more torque than turning a deadbolt, and the duty cycle is high. Expect poor battery life unless the design adds a clutch.
notes.zh: 弹簧是敌人：用电动收回弹簧斜舌比旋转方舌需要更大扭矩，且动作频繁。除非加入离合设计，否则电池续航会很差。

en.q: Is a nightlatch enough on its own?
en.a: No. Insurers expect it alongside a 5-lever deadlock on a timber front door, because a spring latch can be slipped with a card.

en.q: Can a motor drive the inside knob?
en.a: Yes, that is the usual approach — a clamp and motor on the knob. The adapter must tolerate the knob being off-centre relative to the case.

zh.a: 不够。保险公司通常要求木门主门同时装五杆锁，因为弹簧斜舌可以用卡片拨开。

zh.q: 电机能驱动内侧旋钮吗？
zh.a: 可以，这是常见做法——在旋钮上装夹具与电机。适配件必须容忍旋钮相对锁体偏心。
